return [{ json: {
  ok: true,
  op: req.op,
  object_type: row.object_type || "unknown",
  object_id: String(row.object_id || ""),
  is_new: false,
  status: "replayed",
  replayed: true,
  simulated: row.dry_run === true,
  crm: row.dry_run === true ? "none" : "hubspot",
  idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key,
  lead_key: req.lead_key,
  payload_digest: req.payload_digest,
  dry_run: req.dry_run,
  errors: [],
  note: "This idempotency key was already written at " + String(row.written_at || "an earlier run") + ". No second CRM object was created.",
  latency_ms: Date.now() - Number(req.started_at_ms)
} }];

const req = $("Normalise CRM Request").first().json;
const errors = req.validation_errors && req.validation_errors.length
  ? req.validation_errors
  : ["op \"" + req.op + "\" reached the switch fallback, which means it is not one of the three supported operations"];
return [{ json: {
  ok: false,
  op: req.op,
  object_type: "none",
  object_id: "",
  is_new: false,
  status: "rejected",
  replayed: false,
  simulated: false,
  crm: "none",
  idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key,
  lead_key: req.lead_key,
  payload_digest: req.payload_digest,
  dry_run: req.dry_run,
  errors: errors,
  note: "The request was rejected before any CRM call. Nothing was written.",
  latency_ms: Date.now() - Number(req.started_at_ms)
} }];

parameters.content:
## The only HubSpot seam

Every HubSpot call in the whole swarm happens in these three nodes. Add one
`HubSpot App Token` credential here and the entire system writes to a real
portal; leave it empty and `dry_run=true` keeps every other workflow testable.

Contact upsert writes two custom properties, `swarm_lead_score` and
`swarm_lead_tier`. Create them in HubSpot (Settings > Properties) before the
first live run, or remove them from the node.

## Idempotency

The write ledger is checked before the CRM, not after. A replayed webhook, a
retried orchestrator run and a duplicate lead all resolve to the same
`idempotency_key`, so the second call returns the object id from the first
instead of creating a second contact or a duplicate deal.

## Self-test suite

Seven fixtures run through this same service, one at a time. They prove the
parts that do not need a HubSpot credential: deterministic simulation, replay
on a repeated idempotency key, validation rejection before any CRM call, and
the switch fallback for an unknown operation.

C01 and C02 share a run-scoped key, so the suite gives the same verdict however
many times it is run.

description: Reusable, idempotent CRM write service. The only workflow in the swarm that touches HubSpot: three supported operations, a write ledger checked before the CRM so replays never duplicate, and a dry_run branch that simulates deterministic ids with no creden
